prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single universally “best” lawyer — the right attorney depends on your type/severity of injuries, how much you want to litigate vs settle, your location in Atlanta, and your budget. I can, however, help you find a top lawyer for your specific case. To get you started, here’s how to pick the best Atlanta personal‑injury lawyer for a car accident and what to do next.

What to look for in an Atlanta car‑accident lawyer
- Substantial car‑accident/personal‑injury experience (years and percentage of practice devoted to auto crashes).  
- Proven results: settlements/verdicts for cases like yours.  
- Trial experience — many good outcomes require willingness to go to trial.  
- Good local reputation and reviews (Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell, Avvo, Google).  
- Clear contingency fee agreement (common: 33–40% of recovery; expenses may be deducted).  
- Responsive communication and a clear point of contact (who will handle your file).  
- Clean disciplinary record (check the Georgia State Bar).  

Immediate practical steps
- Get medical treatment right away and follow all doctors’ orders.  
- Obtain the police report, photos of the scene/vehicles/injuries, witness contact info, and insurance info.  
- Preserve evidence (vehicle, clothes, damaged items).  
- Don’t give recorded statements to insurers or sign releases without counsel.  

Key legal facts to know
- Georgia’s general personal‑injury statute of limitations is 2 years from the accident date (O.C.G.A. § 9‑3‑33). Don’t delay contacting a lawyer.  
- Most personal‑injury lawyers work on contingency (no recovery = no attorney fee), but confirm details and expenses up front.

Questions to ask at initial consultations (bring police report and medical records)
- How long have you handled car‑accident cases? What percentage of your practice is auto PI?  
- Have you handled cases with injuries like mine? What were the outcomes?  
- Will you handle my case personally or will it be assigned to another attorney/paralegal?  
- What’s your fee structure and what costs will I be responsible for?  
- Do you try cases or primarily settle? How often do you take cases to trial?  
- How do you communicate with clients and how often will I receive updates?  

Where to find and evaluate Atlanta lawyers
- Super Lawyers, Avvo, Martindale‑Hubbell, Google reviews, and the Georgia State Bar (discipline/registration).  
- Ask friends/family for referrals.  
- Interview 3–5 lawyers and compare.

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short list of highly rated Atlanta personal‑injury firms/attorneys (I’ll need your ZIP code or neighborhood), or  
- Draft an email or call script you can use when contacting lawyers for consultations.

Which would you prefer?
